evidence_patterns.pattern_name: structure-before-capture fails under immediate payoff pressure
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool asks the user to decide structure, files, fields, or concepts before the first useful capture happens.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Early value is delayed by table design, vault concepts, plugin understanding, or account-first startup.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: The tool burns the short payoff window before the core action feels routine.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools that let capture happen before system design and keep first value close to the entry surface.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when useful output depends on configuration or conceptual preparation before the first task, note, or time entry.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: account-first access fails when the tool should start now
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool inserts account creation, login state, or cloud dependency before basic use is available.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Starting the tool depends on credentials, sync state, and a hosted workspace instead of opening directly into the job.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: A tool that should feel immediate becomes gated by access mechanics that are unrelated to the work itself.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools that become usable before account maintenance or hosted workspace logic enters the workflow.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when the user has to sign up, sign in, or maintain cloud access before basic capture can begin.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: manual initiation fails under repeated logging
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool depends on explicit starts, stops, switches, or device interactions at every logging moment.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Repeated initiation interrupts the work and turns accuracy into a memory test.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: Tracking completeness collapses first at the initiation layer because the user cannot keep re-starting the system all day.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor passive or lower-interruption capture models that preserve a record even during fragmented work.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when accurate records depend on remembering each timer action or physical switch in the moment.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: care-routine overhead compounds for solo users
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool stays usable only if the user also maintains a routine around planning, hosting, syncing, or platform health.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Normal work is shadowed by daily planning sessions, sync babysitting, or infrastructure care.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: The tool stops disappearing into the workflow and becomes another system that competes for attention.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools that keep working without rituals and keep maintenance from becoming part of ordinary use.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when the user has to keep feeding the method or the infrastructure just to preserve baseline usefulness.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: setup investment fails under short-horizon use
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool expects a longer commitment curve than the actual use window can repay.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Students or temporary users must absorb sync setup, self-hosting, or system learning before getting semester-scale value.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: The decision becomes wrong not because the tool is weak, but because the investment horizon outlasts the need.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools whose payoff arrives inside the temporary window and whose abandonment cost stays low.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when setup, hosting, or learning effort lasts longer than the class, project, or trial period itself.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: hosted dependence fails when control over data or environment becomes the real requirement
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool keeps the system inside a provider-controlled environment when the winning side survives by keeping data or operation closer to the user.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Hosted access feels convenient early, but becomes limiting when data location, environment behavior, or account dependence is itself the bottleneck.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: The workflow outgrows managed convenience because the real constraint becomes who controls the environment.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor local-first or self-managed models when infrastructure boundaries, not features, are what the user is trying to escape.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when the tool cannot keep data or operation inside the user's preferred environment without vendor dependence.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: split surfaces fail when execution must stay attached to context
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool separates the main action from the context needed to complete it, forcing handoffs across surfaces.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Users have to reconnect chat to projects, tickets to live resolution, or booking to checkout after the core step is already underway.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: Execution slows because the system preserves fragments of the workflow in different places instead of keeping the flow intact.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools that keep discussion, resolution, booking, and transaction context inside the same operational path.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when completing the job requires manual stitching across detached communication, service, or transaction surfaces.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: ownership reconstruction fails when responsibility must stay visible
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool makes responsibility legible only after opening items, chasing details, or mentally reconstructing the next owner.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Assignees, follow-up responsibility, or downstream handoffs are not obvious in the main working view.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: Coordination slows because shared understanding depends on extra lookup work instead of visible ownership.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools that keep owners, status, and next-step responsibility visible where the work is scanned.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when users repeatedly ask who owns this, who responds next, or who handles the follow-through after the main action.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: layered navigation fails under all-day retrieval pressure
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool hides the next useful surface behind pages, tabs, channels, or database layers that must be traversed repeatedly.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Finding the right conversation, note, or task takes navigation effort that compounds across the day.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: The interface becomes the bottleneck because access cost overtakes the value of the extra structure it is exposing.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor direct, searchable, or single-surface workflows when the job is dominated by repeated retrieval and quick switches.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when everyday work depends on crossing multiple navigation layers before reaching the next action.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: predictable defaults survive when user-managed state feels fragile
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool asks the user to interpret or reconstruct system state through formulas, sync setup, regeneration logic, or cross-platform behavior.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Routine actions feel risky because correctness depends on remembering how the tool works internally rather than trusting obvious defaults.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: Confidence collapses and normal use slows down once the user no longer trusts that ordinary actions will behave predictably.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor tools that store, sync, and expose state in a way that feels automatic, legible, and hard to misuse.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when correct use depends on managing fragile formulas, custom sync layers, folder setup, or reconstructed credentials.

evidence_patterns.pattern_name: lightweight structures survive early but fail under ceiling pressure
evidence_patterns.repeated_mechanism: The losing tool stays easy only by keeping structure shallow, but later cannot absorb the richer fields, links, integrations, or operational coupling the workflow requires.
evidence_patterns.repeated_friction: Users start compensating with manual workarounds because the simple surface cannot hold the real structure any longer.
evidence_patterns.repeated_failure: The tool works at first, then tops out and forces a rebuild once growth stops being theoretical.
evidence_patterns.survival_direction: Favor deeper structure only when the workflow has clearly crossed from simple capture into durable system behavior.
evidence_patterns.break_condition: Breaks when a lightweight model cannot represent the same work in richer ways without bolting on external process.
